minimum_critical_crop_contract.generalization: applies whenever the same rows could belong to materially different tables or scopes
minimum_critical_crop_contract.requirement: Include meaning-bearing title and scope qualifiers such as consolidated, statement type, measurement scope, or principal-versus-broader population.

minimum_critical_crop_contract.generalization: applies to single-level and multi-level headers
minimum_critical_crop_contract.requirement: Include as-of versus years-ended basis, complete dates, and the header path binding each numeric column to its period and role.

minimum_critical_crop_contract.generalization: applies even when currency symbols appear on selected values
minimum_critical_crop_contract.requirement: Include the currency and every unit or scale band governing the captured rows, including mixed scale sections.

minimum_critical_crop_contract.generalization: applies to continuations, stacked tables, and nested reconciliations
minimum_critical_crop_contract.requirement: Do not begin or end inside a logical statement fragment; preserve row groups, totals, secondary tables, and continuation identity needed to interpret them.

minimum_critical_crop_contract.generalization: decorative footer and page furniture are not required
